This is a newly added, non-trivial hook file (it aggregates four Onyx subscriptions and derives a loading state), but it opens straight into `import` statements with no header comment. A one-line header orients the next reader immediately instead of forcing them to reverse-engineer the file's purpose.

Add a short header describing what the hook provides, e.g.:

```ts
/**
 * Reads the Onyx state needed to open or resume a Wallet-initiated personal bank account setup,
 * and reports whether that state is still loading.
 */

```
